verdict.rationale: decK provides declarative bulk sync of many Gateway/Konnect entities at once (kong-docs-4, kong-probe-4), and Insomnia's Inso CLI/test runner supports automating and executing unlimited test runs across collections (kong-docs-28, kong-docs-42), giving genuine bulk-operation tooling usable by automation/AI-driven pipelines. However, this is CLI/config-sync bulk operation rather than an AI-agent-native bulk API (e.g., no documented batch endpoint on the Admin API or MCP server for programmatically operating on many resources in one agent call). Missing for 10: evidence of a bulk/batch REST or MCP endpoint an AI agent could call directly, and independent hands-on confirmation of bulk operations at scale (only official docs and a version-check probe are available).
